prompts: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE proposal board showing TWO separate VERTICAL rectangular poster faces side by side, equal size, each 2:3 portrait proportions, a narrow dark blue-gray gutter and outer margin. This is illustration artwork for children's theater protest placards in Quelec y la semilla del futuro, to be reviewed BEFORE any application to a 3D model. No poles, people carrying signs, physical mockups, perspective, or 3D renders. Each face has warm ivory matte paper background, extremely bold hand-cut-paper shapes, rich indigo and forest green, ochre and warm brown, chunky charcoal contours, subtle gouache/paper grain. Friendly theatrical childhood imagination, artisanal origami-world feel, NOT realistic photography or generic highway signage. Very simple large silhouettes, picture occupies most of each face and reads from far across a plaza. On EACH picture paint one very broad vivid red diagonal brush slash from lower left to upper right to mean forbidden; leave enough of the motif recognizable. Do not enclose the slash in a circle or a traffic-sign border. Absolutely NO TEXT, letters, numbers, captions, labels, logos or watermarks anywhere. Do not add decorative scenery or small details. LEFT face, forbidden DREAMING: an unmistakable sleeping child's head on a simple pillow, with one large dream cloud containing a big crescent moon and two big stars above it. RIGHT face, forbidden USING IMAGINATION: a child with open eye in profile, a very large colorful folded origami bird emerging from an open thought cloud above the head, a creative idea coming alive. Clearly distinct symbols. Keep both pictograms bold and sparse.
